_comment: READ-ONLY CAPTURE PROFILE — targets the POS Screen sale window, not the back-office frame.
The ProfileVersion below deliberately still contains 'PENDING', so this profile can never
pass TerminalSelectorReadiness and can never be mistaken for live-ready. It exists only to
aim a passive control-tree capture at the correct window.
Window selection is now declarative rather than a single title hint. The 2026-09-04 13:07:59
capture bound 'Idealpos v7.1 Build 33  Sila Restaurant  DUNEDIN - BACKOFFICE(1)'
(class ThunderRT6MDIForm, IsWindowVisible=false) because that title contains the hint
'Idealpos' while the real sale window 'POS Screen' (class ThunderRT6FormDC, visible) does not.
